nodes.label: DB.NewTransaction / Txn
nodes.desc: Users open ACID transactions with serializable snapshot isolation; keys are versioned with a commit timestamp.

nodes.label: oracle (SSI conflict detection)
nodes.desc: Tracks read/commit timestamps and committed key sets to detect read-write conflicts between transactions.

nodes.label: DB.doWrites worker
nodes.desc: Committed entries are batched into requests and funneled through a single write channel with throttling.

nodes.label: valueLog.write (WiscKey value log)
nodes.desc: Values are appended sequentially to append-only value log files; the LSM only stores a valuePointer.

nodes.label: memTable.Put + WAL logFile
nodes.desc: Each write goes into the active memtable and its write-ahead log (logFile) for crash recovery.

nodes.label: Skiplist.Put on Arena
nodes.desc: The memtable is a lock-free skiplist backed by a pre-allocated arena buffer.

nodes.label: DB.flushMemtable
nodes.desc: A dedicated goroutine drains flushChan, rotating full memtables into immutable ones and flushing them.

nodes.label: table.Builder (SST format)
nodes.desc: Builds sorted-string-tables: blocks with prefix compression, per-block checksums, index and bloom filter.

nodes.label: levelsController (L0 + compaction)
nodes.desc: Manages the level hierarchy: registers L0 tables, picks compaction priorities and runs compactors.

nodes.label: Manifest changes
nodes.desc: Every table create/delete is journaled as a ManifestChangeSet so the LSM tree can be rebuilt on restart.

nodes.label: DB.get / Txn.Get
nodes.desc: Reads probe memtables newest-first, then descend the levels; values are fetched from the value log.

nodes.label: MergeIterator
nodes.desc: Heap-merges iterators from memtables and every level, exposing the newest version of each key.
